occurrences.checkable_against: Florida Department of Health in Broward County mosquito-borne illness prevention guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Control mosquitoes inside and outside. Repair damaged screening on windows, doors, porches, and patios. Drain water from garbage cans, buckets, pool covers, coolers, toys, flowerpots, or any other containers where sprinkler or rainwater has collected.
